# Siyuan Peng personal site

This directory is a dependency-free GitHub Pages site. It contains only static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, so it can be deployed without a local build step.

## Publish it

1. Create the public GitHub repository `siyuanpeng88-oss.github.io` under the `siyuanpeng88-oss` account.
2. Copy these files to that repository's root and push to its default branch.
3. In GitHub, open **Settings > Pages**, set **Source** to **GitHub Actions**, then push the included workflow.

The published site will be available at `https://siyuanpeng88-oss.github.io/`.

## Content notes

The site uses career details from the supplied resume. It intentionally omits the resume's street address, phone number, and personal email. Update `index.html` to add an email contact method later if desired.
